meta.title: Model Probe
meta.description: Test model connectivity, behavioral fingerprints, local intelligence benchmarks, latency, token usage, and SVG generation.

title: Model Probe
subtitle: Check live connectivity, behavioral fingerprints, an 18-item intelligence battery, and animated or custom SVG generation
customSvgPlaceholder: Describe the picture, even briefly; SVG-only output instructions are added automatically…
customSvgHint: A short subject is enough. The plugin automatically adds complete SVG output instructions.
customPromptRequired: Enter a custom SVG prompt first
svgNotice: Native SVG animation is preserved; scripts, external resources, and events are removed.
svgPromptHint: Generate a looping animated SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle
fingerprintPartial: Some probes failed; this fingerprint uses completed samples only
fingerprintHint: Fast fingerprint by default: four temperature-0 preference probes form an identity signature compared against every model recorded locally, so a shared signature means a shared backend, and four tokenizer probes show which tokenizer family the endpoint actually uses; enable Full fingerprint to add the seven behavioral probes and three sampling runs; the self-reported name is reference only
quickModeHint: Limits output to 3,000 bytes and 30 elements by default; disable to allow 12,000 bytes and 100 elements.
empty: No testable models found. Add a provider and models in Model Settings.
footnote: Uses current DSH model routes. Keys stay on the Host and never reach this page.
intelligencePartial: Some questions failed; the score uses completed items only
intelligenceHint: Local 18-item weighted benchmark; mirrors a public report shape, not an IQ test or a cross-model ranking
htmlNotice: Inline styles and CSS animation are preserved; scripts, external resources, and events are removed.
htmlHint: Full HTML artifacts; inline <style> and CSS animation are allowed
htmlPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the built-in pelican-on-a-bicycle animation, or describe your own scene
htmlDefaultHint: Empty runs the built-in brief (a looping pelican-on-a-bicycle animation); fill in a subject to use your own.
fingerprintCacheWarn: Some samples hit the upstream cache; the distribution may be distorted
fingerprintInsufficient: Not enough samples for a signature
identityFirstSeen: first record, nothing to compare yet
identityPeerWarn: These rows answer the identity probes byte for byte like this one; they may be the same backend
tokenizerWarn: This endpoint does not use the tokenizer of the family it advertises — the relay most likely forwards to a different model
fingerprintModeFast: Fast fingerprint: 4 identity probes + 4 tokenizer probes, the default
fingerprintModeFull: Full fingerprint: also runs 7 behavioral probes and 3 sampling runs, for availability and sampler checks
identityAloneHint: The signature comparison only covers rows this machine has tested. On a fresh install nothing can match until you probe other models too; that is not a verdict on this model.
tokenizerUnknownHint: These counts are not close to any vector in the public reference: the endpoint may use an unpublished vocabulary or a different serving template. That is not by itself a problem.
tokenizerCloseHint: One count away from this reference vector, which usually means a probe raced a routing switch; run it again to confirm.
tokenizerAmbiguousHint: These counts hit two families at once, and the missing dimension is the only thing that separates them; measure it again or use another endpoint to tell them apart.
tokenizerInsufficientHint: Fewer than three of the four probes returned a usable count, so the vector is incomplete and no family can be decided.
tokenizerUnstableHint: The reason is routing: the same text counts differently on two calls, so the baseline cannot be subtracted.
identityFluctuatingHint: these probes no longer count toward identity: one answer drifting is an unstable probe, not a swapped model.
